research.topic: Body‑image worries (negative thoughts about one’s own shape, size, or appearance)
verified: A notable proportion of university‑educated women express concerns about body image, though exact prevalence is unclear.
Periods of high academic stress may be linked to heightened body dissatisfaction, but evidence is limited.
Frequent scrolling of appearance‑focused social media predicts greater thin‑ideal internalisation and lower self‑esteem

sources.title: Social Media Use and Body Image Disorders: Association between Frequency of Comparing One's Own Physical Appearance to That of People Being Followed on Social M
The Impact of Social Media on Eating Disorder Risk and Self-Esteem Among Adolescents and Young Adults: A Psychosocial Analysis in Individuals Aged 16-25.
Beauty ideals, social media, and body positivity: A qualitative investigation of influences on body image among young women in Japan.
Addressing nutritional issues and eating behaviours among university students: a narrative review.

research.hook: Stop doing these 3 things if you want to stop letting your body‑image worries hijack your research productivity.
research.tip: After each 45‑minute work block, take a 2‑minute neutral‑focus break: look away, stand, and silently list three functional aspects of your body.
dropped: ~1 in 4 adults worldwide experience significant body‑image concerns (unsupported)
Sleeping less than 6 hours per night amplifies negative self‑evaluation (uncertain + number not backed)
Negative self‑talk triggers cortisol rise and reinforces body‑image distress (unsupported)
Talking about body‑image worries with trusted peers reduces isolation and improves coping (unsupported)

data.title: Stop these 3 habits that wreck your body image and research
data.title_en: Stop these 3 habits that damage body image and productivity

scenes.text: Kya tum apni body image se pareshan ho?
scenes.text_en: Are you worried about your body image?
scenes.text_hi: क्या तुम अपनी बॉडी इमेज से परेशान हो?

scenes.text: Jab exams aate hain, hum apni shape pe zyada sochte hain.
scenes.text_en: During exams, we think more about our shape.
scenes.text_hi: जब एग्जाम्स आते हैं, हम अपनी शेप पे ज़्यादा सोचते हैं।

scenes.text: Social media ko bina limit scroll karna.
scenes.text_hi: सोशल मीडिया को बिना लिमिट स्क्रॉल करना।

scenes.text: Apne aap ko dusron ke perfect photos se compare karna.
scenes.text_en: Comparing yourself to others' perfect photos.
scenes.text_hi: अपने आप को दूसरों के परफेक्ट फोटोस से कंपेयर करना।

scenes.text: Stress ke time me body ko ignore karna.
scenes.text_en: Ignoring your body during stress periods.
scenes.text_hi: स्ट्रेस के टाइम में बॉडी को इग्नोर करना।

scenes.text: Research suggests, university‑educated women often worry about looks.
scenes.text_en: Research shows educated women often worry about looks.
scenes.text_hi: रिसर्च बताती है, यूनिवर्सिटी‑एजुकेटेड महिलाएँ अक्सर लुक्स की चिंता करती हैं।

scenes.text: High academic stress may increase body dissatisfaction, though evidence limited.
scenes.text_en: High academic stress may raise body dissatisfaction, evidence limited.
scenes.text_hi: हाई अकादमिक स्ट्रेस बॉडी डिससैटिस्फैक्शन बढ़ा सकता है, हालांकि एविडेंस लिमिटेड है।

scenes.text: Scrolling appearance‑focused feeds predicts thin‑ideal internalisation and lower self‑esteem.
scenes.text_en: Scrolling appearance‑focused feeds predicts thin‑ideal internalisation and lower self‑esteem.
scenes.text_hi: एपियरेंस‑फोकस्ड फीड स्क्रॉल करने से थिन‑आइडल इंटर्नलाइज़ेशन और लोअर सेल्फ‑एस्टीम बढ़ता है।

scenes.text: Ab har 45 minute ke baad, 2 minute ka neutral break lo.
scenes.text_en: After each 45‑minute block, take a 2‑minute neutral break.
scenes.text_hi: अब हर 45 मिनट के बाद, 2 मिनट का न्यूट्रल ब्रेक लो।

scenes.text: Pehle dekh, phir khade ho, teen functional aspects likho.
scenes.text_en: First look away, then stand, list three functional aspects.
scenes.text_hi: पहले देख, फिर खड़े हो, तीन फ़ंक्शनल एस्पेक्ट्स लिखो।

scenes.text: Yeh chhote break tumhari body‑image ko calm karenge.
scenes.text_en: These short breaks will calm your body image.
scenes.text_hi: ये छोटे ब्रेक तुम्हारी बॉडी‑इमेज को क़ाम कर देंगे।

scenes.text: Ye tip apne study buddy ko bhejo, dono ko fayda.
scenes.text_en: Send this tip to your study buddy, both benefit.
scenes.text_hi: ये टिप अपने स्टडी बडी को भेजो, दोनों को फ़ायदा।

data.description: A quick reel showing three habits that worsen body‑image worries during study periods, backed by research, and a simple 2‑minute neutral break to reset your mindset.

Add a quick visual cue or text overlay to reinforce each beat every 2‑3 scenes
